dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Ah, so you have a business here in Snezhnaya.

dialogues.speaker: West Screen
dialogues.text: Yes. There's still some paperwork to be done, but I suppose you can say that.

dialogues.speaker: West Screen
dialogues.text: I'm just out here looking at market conditions in various places while the shop isn't open yet. Just in case I missed anything.

dialogues.speaker: West Screen
dialogues.text: As you know, doing business is like going to war. Gotta know your enemies to stay alive. Am I right?
